body:
Added #target {:java (inline-java ...)} to src/emit_java.c (previously had zero FFI of any kind), mirroring the C emitter's own :c hatch. First consumer: stdlib/hw/usb_serial.prn, verified end-to-end via a real parena build + javac round trip against a hand-written stub (no Android SDK in this sandbox). 43/43 emit_java tests pass. Commit PARENA@6e2cba0.

⚓ ☃
title: New Java emitter FFI hatch + hw/usb_serial.prn for EDGE.GAME
